page: Amazon Web Services i8g.24xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processors. Built on the arm64 architecture, it features 96 dedicated physical cores running at 2.8 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The memory configuration consists of 768 GB of RAM, providing 8 GB per core. For local storage, the instance includes 22,500 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 56 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is a key strength, achieving top-tier ratings in both small-block cached reads and large-block uncached read/write operations. The system also demonstrates top-tier capabilities in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput. However, single-core performance, including Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core CPU metrics, remains in the average tier.

Given the massive local NVMe SSD capacity and high memory bandwidth, this instance offers high resource density for data-intensive environments. The qualitative cost efficiency is highly favorable for workloads requiring local, high-speed storage coupled with massive parallel processing, avoiding the overhead of external network storage. It is optimally suited for large-scale databases, Redis caching layers, high-throughput web serving, and multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
